name: Anal'a Tu'wha
location: Dragonstar Arena, Round 5: The Celestial Ring

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.description: A melee attack that deals moderate physical damage and knocks you back if it connects. This attack can be blocked to knock Anal'a Tu'wha off balance.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Anal'a Tu'wha swings their weapon around, dealing minor physical damage to all enemies in front of them. This attack has no red cone indicator.

abilities.name: Flames of Oblivion
abilities.description: During combat, Anal'a Tu'wha summons a large fire field around in the form of a circular AoE, dealing continuous high flame damage. The field lingers for a long time.

abilities.name: Standard of Might
abilities.description: The attack is a circular AoE and causes flame damage over time.

abilities.name: Engulfing Flames
abilities.description: Anal'a Tu'wha breathes fire as indicated by a red cone. This attack does moderate flame damage over time and snares all enemies within the cone. This attack can be blocked to reduce damage or simply avoided.

abilities.name: Unstable Flame
abilities.description: Anal'a Tu'wha casts a Venomous Claw-like ability to a target that deal both instant damage and damage over time.

mechanics.description: During combat, Anal'a Tu'wha summons a large fire field around in the form of a circular AoE, dealing continuous high flame damage. The field lingers for a long time.

summary: Anal'a Tu'wha is an undead Anka-Ra warrior encountered in the Dragonstar Arena. He is the boss of the fifth round, the Celestial Ring.
